payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jung, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

payload.content: Hello team, I have 5 hours available and strong skills in frontend (0.87) and security (0.80). I see several low priority tasks on ISSUE-0001 (security) and ISSUE-0002 (frontend). Given my availability, I am interested in claiming a task with effort close to or less than 5 hours and good skill match to keep my cost low. I prefer tasks from ISSUE-0002 since they have lower effort and fit my skills well, specifically review or test tasks. I would like to know if anyone else is planning to claim these or other tasks on ISSUE-0002.

Hello Jung, I have 4 hours available and strong security (0.98) and frontend (0.70) skills. I see you are interested in ISSUE-0002 tasks (frontend review or test). I am also interested in ISSUE-0002 review or test tasks given my availability and cost. Could you please clarify which task you might claim so we avoid duplicates? I am leaning towards ISSUE-0002 review or test as well.

Hello Jung and Linnea, I have 10 hours available and strong frontend (0.72) and security (0.67) skills. I see you both are interested in ISSUE-0002 review or test tasks. I want to avoid conflicts and maximize tasks done. Since my cost for ISSUE-0002 review is 1.23 and for test is 1.72, I am open to either, but if you want one of these tasks, I can consider other tasks like ISSUE-0002 implement (effort 2.0, cost 2.45) or ISSUE-0001 triage (effort 2.8, cost 3.66). Please share your preferences so we can coordinate.
